What is Axom AI Research?

Axom AI Research is the home of technical reports from Axom AI, Assam's first indigenous generative AI platform. Each report explains a system we built, the data and tools behind it, the results we measured on data the model had never seen, and the places where it still fails.

Featured research

Computer vision · Road safety30 min readOct 26, 2026

Helmet Detection: every rider checked, from a phone video or a CCTV camera

An end-to-end system: YOLOv8 detection, per-rider tracking, an Android app, an admin dashboard and live CCTV alerts. Recall on held-out CCTV frames rose from 0.62 to 0.79 after fine-tuning; the live worker caught about 90% of bare-headed riders at two analysed frames per second.
